title: Algerian Man Hit by Car Is Visited by Jesus, Mohammed, Shiva, and Female Deity

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt alone and "floating" at incredible speed; later "lightness" and sharp awareness of essence.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified "the Lord Jesus" and "the Prophet Mohammed"; a third male figure introduced himself as "the god Shiva."
arrival.other_being_detail: A recurring young girl guide; a tall woman with long hair (female deity/presence) who said, "This is the second time I've seen you" and later "She is my daughter, take care of her" and "Remember, I am everywhere."

environment.environment_other_detail: Hospital-like rooms/hallway with silhouettes of light and darker silhouettes; later a path/platform with red earth and golden sand shifting to crystalline/indescribable ground; sky used as a display surface; "luminous spacecraft" show.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told by the tall feminine presence: "She is my daughter, take care of her."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hit by a car at ~80 km/h during sandstorm/darkness; severe fractures and bleeding; later deep coma.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Recited the Shahada during transport: "I bear witness that there is no deity but God, and that Mohammed is His prophet and messenger."
person_demographics.occupation: Hotel worker (hotel establishment in the Sahara)

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Rectangular protective light/dome at accident scene; hospital-room realm with light/dark silhouettes; large assembly with nonhuman biological forms and "luminous spacecraft" demonstrations; sky-writing/portraits of prophets/scientists; frequent post-NDE "visits from the deceased".
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Protective light and girl appeared at accident scene before tunnel; OBE included transport/hospital corridor/operating room; later a hospital-room realm with figures, then boundary-restricted exploration and assembly; then return after coma.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The young girl guide reappeared multiple times; multiple transitions between hospital/operating-room OBE and other realms.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: At points he perceived both his own body on a stretcher/operating table and himself as separate/being propelled forward.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Rectangular light securing the accident site "like a protective dome"; multi-religious visitation (Jesus, Mohammed, Shiva, plus unknown female figure); hospital-realm filled with light and dark silhouettes; large interspecies assembly with many biological forms; "spectacular display of luminous spacecraft" and technological/cosmic-spiritual narratives; later claimed to identify/find the young girl as a specific person ("Rosa Sanz").
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Look closely at this light—it’s here to protect you."; "Don’t fall asleep, don’t close your eyes."; "Make way, the Lord is coming. Step aside and clear the path."; "Now, you have grace."; "I was allowed to explore an unfamiliar space, but with clear restrictions"; "She is my daughter, take care of her."; "Remember, I am everywhere."
